story.heading: Upper State Road, North Wales
paragraphs: Eastern Dragon sits at 830 Upper State Rd. with a kitchen that runs Chinese and Japanese on the same ticket.
You come in, you call (215) 855-0366, or you send the order out. Szechuan Chicken is the dish the site still names first.
Find them at 830 Upper State Rd., North Wales, PA 19454. Call (215) 855-0366. Hours: Sun-Thurs 11:00 am - 9:30 pm. Confirm details on the official site before you drive.

experience.heading: How dinner actually moves.
items: Walk in for a table, or call ahead if you already know the order.
Take out and delivery cover the nights you aren't sitting down.
Catering is on the board when the count is bigger than a booth.

feature.heading: Szechuan Chicken, then the rest of the menu
feature.text: The kitchen is built for the regular order. Spice, rice, and a second cuisine if the table wants Japanese next to the Chinese plates. Szechuan Chicken and the rest of the Chinese board, cooked for dine in or the ride home.
